p.name: Félagsheimili Patreksfjarðar
p.opening_hours: "This is the community house. it houses larger events like dances, parties, raffles, traveling shops etc. Skjaldborg Film Festival has at least one event here, Sailor's day weekend has two dances, the Blues Festival 'Milli Fjalls og fjöru' hosts here."
